mlag.note: MLAG is listed under Layer 2 features, but the datasheet marks its 'Cognitive Campus Resilience' section (MLAG, SSU) with the not-yet-supported asterisk

stacking.note: No hardware stacking on the datasheet. Arista SWAG (Switch Aggregation Group) can combine switches into one logical system over standard Ethernet links, but per-platform support is not published publicly

verifyNote: SWAG support is not on the datasheet and Arista's platform list is behind a login. If confirmed, set stacking.tech to SWAG and take the member limit and port usage from the platform documentation, not the general 48-switch figure. Multichassis LAG: the datasheet lists MLAG without an asterisk but flags the resilience section containing it as not currently supported in EOS; confirm MLAG is shipping

routing.summary: EOS Layer 3: static, OSPFv2/v3, IS-IS, BGP/MP-BGP, RIPv2, VRRP, VRF, PBR. PIM, VXLAN and EVPN are listed as not yet supported. Industrial protocols: PROFINET, MODBUS. Dynamic routing needs the Enhanced license (Group 2)

power.summary: 28TXH: two hot-swap internal 400W AC/HVDC PSUs. 20TNH: up to two external adapters, 480W AC or 290W DC. Fanless

redundancy.detail: 1+1. On the 20TNH the second supply does not add PoE budget; on the 28TXH the 720W budget is with both PSUs

licensing: Base EOS included. OSPF, IS-IS, BGP and PIM need the Enhanced license (LIC-FIX-G2-E); FLX-Lite adds up to 32K routes. Also manageable with CloudVision CUE (subscription)
note: Rated -40 to 75C in a fan-equipped enclosure, 70C ventilated, 60C sealed. Vibration and shock rated (IEC 60068, MIL-STD-810), IEEE 1613 and IEC 61850-3. Minimum EOS is TBD for both models on the Aug 2026 datasheet

models.poweredBy: External adapters, sold separately (PWR-462-AC-ADP-H or PWR-462-DC-ADP-H)
models.verifyNote: The datasheet states 144 Gbps; the port total (16x 1G + 4x 5G + 4x 10G) is 152 Gbps full duplex. Datasheet value kept
